newsitem.title: POLAND: Stalexport hopes for Malaysian contract.
newsitem.headline: Stalexport hopes for Malaysian contract.

text.p: Polish steel trader Stalexport SA is in talks with Malaysian authorities on taking part in the country's railway investment programme worth $2 billion, a senior Stalexport official said on Tuesday.

Andrzej Lis told a news conference, summing up a two-day Polish-Asian forum in Warsaw, that Stalexport hoped to win contracts for railway tracks worth between 10 and 15 percent of the programme over the next three years.
"We are interested in participating in the Malaysian railway investment programme," Lis said.
"Over three years investment there could reach $2 billion so it would be good to get contracts for 10 to 15 percent of that sum," he said. He gave no further details.
